title.narrative: Humanitarian Assistance to Vulnerable Countries Affected by the COVID-19 Pandemic

description.narrative: The overall impact of the proposed action is the containment of the spread of COVID-19 in the targeted communities and the decrease and prevention of disease and malnutrition, including the decrease of loss of livelihoods and human assets. The outcomes we aim for is that target communities have taken the appropriate measures to stop COVID-19 transmission within the community and that the overall food and nutrition security of the target groups is not further impacted by the COVID-19 crisis. This will be achieved through access to humanitarian assistance across multiple response sectors, and protection services for human assets, social cohesion, rights and livelihoods enhancement
